articles.title: Lucky Strike Entertainment Posts $302.6M Revenue in Q3 2026, EPS Remains Negative
articles.summary: Lucky Strike Entertainment reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $302.64M with an EPS of -$0.21, offering a real-time financial benchmark for the broader FEC and bowling-entertainment sector. Investors and operators can use these figures to gauge industry-wide demand trends heading into the holiday quarter. The results highlight ongoing profitability challenges even as top-line revenue remains robust for large-scale FEC chains.

articles.title: ESAC Uses Shanghai WUNPARK Case Study to Outline 2027 FEC Design Trends
articles.summary: Industry design firm ESAC examines the Shanghai WUNPARK project as a blueprint for the shift from attraction-mix venues to fully integrated social destinations in FEC design. The analysis identifies key 2027 trends including socializing-first layouts, mixed-use programming, and experiential retail integration. FEC operators planning new builds or renovations should take note of these evolving guest expectations.

articles.title: LEVEL99 Confirms Opening Date for West Hartford Location
articles.summary: LEVEL99, the puzzle-based competitive entertainment concept, has set an opening date for its West Hartford venue, continuing the brand's national expansion. The concept blends physical challenges, social gaming, and food-and-beverage into a single destination, making it a direct competitive benchmark for FEC operators. Its growth trajectory offers useful data points on consumer appetite for adult-oriented experiential entertainment.

articles.title: KWICKFUN Launches Mobile-First Platform for FEC Admissions, Payments, and Access Control
articles.summary: KWICKFUN has introduced a mobile platform that consolidates admissions, access control, guest services, and payments into a single handheld device, eliminating the need for fixed infrastructure at every attraction point. The system supports both credit/debit cards and house game card payments via Adyen integration, giving operators flexibility without costly hardware installations. For FEC operators looking to reduce capex on infrastructure while improving guest flow, this is a compelling operational tool.

articles.title: TwinkleTwinkleStar and Ventola Projects Partner to Turn Party Rooms into Revenue-Generating Attractions
articles.summary: TwinkleTwinkleStar has announced a collaboration with UK-based Ventola Projects to bring interactive LED lighting, wireless audio, and video display technology into FEC party rooms. The patent-pending system is designed to transform underutilized party spaces into immersive, bookable entertainment environments that drive incremental revenue. This is directly relevant for FEC operators seeking to maximize per-square-foot returns from birthday and group event spaces.

articles.title: 'Masha and the Three Bears' IP Launches First Family Entertainment Center Concept
articles.summary: The popular children's IP 'Masha and the Three Bears' is entering the physical FEC space with its first branded family entertainment center. IP-driven FEC concepts continue to gain traction as operators seek differentiation and built-in audience loyalty. This move signals growing interest from children's media brands in location-based entertainment as a revenue channel.

articles.title: BrushBoarding Brings Waterless Surf Attraction to IAAPA Expo 2026
articles.summary: BrushBoarding, a waterless surfing experience designed for FECs and leisure venues, will exhibit a full-size ramp at IAAPA Expo 2026 in Orlando this November. The attraction targets the competitive socializing segment, encouraging repeat visits as guests work to improve their balance and surfing skills. FEC operators attending IAAPA can experience the product firsthand at booth W1058, with limited demo slots available.

articles.title: Blue Motion Games to Debut John Wick: Continental Pursuit Motion Arcade at IAAPA Expo 2026
articles.summary: Blue Motion Games will showcase John Wick: Continental Pursuit at IAAPA Expo 2026, marking the game's first major US public exhibition following a summer launch at a large American chain. The attraction features 3DOF motion seats, force-feedback blasters, and a 75-inch HD screen with multi-level licensed gameplay across New York, Miami, and Guanajuato settings. For FEC operators seeking premium licensed arcade experiences, this is a high-profile product to evaluate at the show.

articles.title: Premiere Cinemas Expanding at South Plains Mall with Large-Format Family Entertainment Center
articles.summary: Premiere Cinemas is adding a major family entertainment center to its South Plains Mall location, reflecting the ongoing trend of cinema operators diversifying into broader entertainment to combat declining moviegoing. The expansion underscores how malls and theater chains are repositioning as full-service entertainment destinations. FEC operators should monitor this hybrid cinema-FEC model as a growing competitive format.

articles.title: Complete Sports and Management India Wins Two New FEC Project Contracts
articles.summary: BSE-listed Complete Sports and Management India (CSML) has secured contracts for two new family entertainment center projects, signaling continued FEC investment momentum in the Indian market. The wins reflect expanding operator and investor interest in FEC infrastructure across South Asia. This is a useful indicator for suppliers and international FEC brands considering market entry or partnerships in the region.

articles.title: Bowling Alley Reborn: Nostalgia Drives New FEC Investment in Wisconsin
articles.summary: A community bowling alley in Ozaukee County is being revived by new ownership inspired by fond local memories, illustrating how emotional connection to legacy venues can serve as a foundation for FEC redevelopment. The story highlights a broader trend of independent operators breathing new life into shuttered bowling centers. For suppliers and consultants, this represents an ongoing pipeline of renovation and refit opportunities in the bowling segment.

articles.title: Pensacola's Pelican Opens as New Indoor Entertainment Complex
articles.summary: A new indoor entertainment complex called The Pelican has opened in Pensacola, Florida, adding to the growing number of FEC-style venues launching in secondary markets across the US Southeast. The venue's format and attraction mix offer a useful case study for operators considering similar markets. Opening activity in mid-sized cities continues to demonstrate healthy consumer demand for indoor entertainment outside major metros.

articles.title: Registration Opens for Ride Camp Safety Conference 2027 in San Antonio
articles.summary: International Ride Training (IRT) has opened registration for Ride Camp Safety Conference 2027, taking place February 1-5 in San Antonio, Texas. The event is a leading professional development and safety education platform for amusement and water park operators and is directly relevant for FEC venues with rides and mechanical attractions. Early registration is recommended as this is a key annual calendar event for operations and safety teams.

articles.title: Magic Playground Introduces Programmable Multi-Use Venue Concept for Parks and FECs
articles.summary: Magic Playground has launched what it calls the first 'programmable venue,' a single footprint that transforms between a splash pad, interactive game arena, multimedia show space, and dry event stage via a walk-in LED floor system with integrated water fountains and sensors. The concept is pitched directly at parks and FECs as a way to generate multiple revenue streams from one attraction footprint, reducing idle time and improving ROI per square meter. This modular, all-season approach to venue design is highly relevant for operators looking to maximize underutilized outdoor or semi-covered space.

articles.title: Merlin Entertainments Upgrading Accessible Queue System to Virtual Queue App in 2027
articles.summary: Merlin Entertainments will roll out a redesigned Ride Access Pass (RAP) system in 2027, replacing physical queuing for guests with disabilities with a virtual queue managed via a mobile app. The move reflects growing operator focus on accessibility and inclusive guest experience as both a compliance issue and a differentiator. FEC operators of all sizes should track this shift as guest expectations around accessibility continue to rise industry-wide.

articles.title: Memoir Creative Expands Experience Business, Appoints Former RWS Global Executive as Chief Growth Officer
articles.summary: Memoir Creative has named Kevin Kreczko, formerly of RWS Global and Bass Pro Shops, as its Chief Growth Officer as it expands its creative, fabrication, and production services to theme parks, cruise lines, and destination venues. The company operates from a 50,000-square-foot production facility with more than 40 full-time specialists. For FEC operators seeking turnkey experience design and production partners, Memoir Creative's expanded capabilities are worth evaluating.

articles.title: SimEx-Iwerks Extends BBC Earth Partnership, Adds Two New 4D Experiences Available from March 2027
articles.summary: SimEx-Iwerks has renewed its licensing deal with BBC Studios and developed two new 4D Experiences based on the acclaimed Mammals series, available for venue licensing starting March 2027. The partnership continues to offer FEC and attraction operators a proven content pipeline from one of the world's most trusted natural history brands. Operators with 4D or large-format cinema capabilities should inquire about licensing terms ahead of the spring 2027 availability window.

articles.title: Fun Spot America Launches Black Friday Season Pass Sale for 2027
articles.summary: Fun Spot America is running a Black Friday promotion from November 13-30 with discounted 2027 season pass and ultimate season pass pricing across its Orlando and Kissimmee parks. The campaign illustrates the ongoing importance of advance pass sales as a revenue and loyalty tool for FEC operators heading into the new year. Independent FEC operators should take note of this promotional timing strategy to drive early cash flow.

articles.title: EAG360 Launches Best of Show Awards for 2027, Open to Amusement and Gaming Exhibitors
articles.summary: EAG360 has opened entries for its 2027 Best of Show Awards, covering the Amuse Expo, CompSocUK, and London Gaming Show exhibitions, with winners announced live on the floor in January 2027. The free-to-enter program is designed to highlight innovation across entertainment, amusements, and gaming, with a specific category for competitive socializing venue technology. FEC suppliers exhibiting at EAG360 should consider entering before the December 18 deadline.

articles.title: Wisconsin Bar Adds Indoor Golf Simulators to Drive Winter Revenue
articles.summary: A Beloit, Wisconsin pub has installed indoor golf simulators as a strategy to attract customers during the slower winter season, joining a growing number of hospitality venues integrating simulator-based entertainment. The move reflects the rapid crossover between F&B and FEC-style attractions in bar and restaurant settings. FEC operators competing with these hybrid hospitality-entertainment venues should be aware of this trend in their local markets.

articles.title: LOFIL Play & Sports Energy Hub Targets Mall FEC Operators with Modular Hybrid Concept
articles.summary: LOFIL has introduced a new-generation hybrid play and sports socializing concept designed specifically for commercial mall environments, blending indoor playground equipment, light sports, trend art, and original IP content. The modular spatial design deploys flexibly across mall atriums and varied floorplates, targeting both family and young adult audiences. The full-chain offering, from space planning through ongoing operations, positions LOFIL as a potential turnkey solution provider for mall-based FEC operators.

articles.title: ISE 2027's Spark Event Moves to Larger Venue, Highlighting Tech-Themed Entertainment Crossover
articles.summary: The Spark program at ISE 2027, focused on the intersection of AV technology and themed entertainment, is relocating to a larger venue at Fira Montjuïc in February 2027. The event is increasingly relevant to FEC operators integrating projection mapping, interactive displays, and immersive AV systems into their attractions. Operators and suppliers interested in cutting-edge entertainment technology should add ISE 2027 to their event calendar.

articles.title: Moment Factory Transforms Legacy Projection Building into Gamified Walkthrough at Futuroscope
articles.summary: La Serre des Mondes, developed by Moment Factory for Futuroscope in France and opening February 2026, converts a 360-degree projection building into a 16.5-minute multi-room interactive walkthrough accommodating 60-80 visitors per cycle. The project replaces passive viewing with gamified, ambulatory storytelling across four distinct spaces engaging multiple senses. FEC designers and operators can draw on this case study when evaluating how to evolve or repurpose existing screen-based attractions.

articles.title: Six Flags Over Georgia Returns Holiday in the Park with New Immersive Experiences
articles.summary: Six Flags Over Georgia is relaunching Holiday in the Park on November 21 with new immersive elements including millions of lights, live entertainment, interactive characters, and holiday storytelling. The seasonal overlay strategy continues to be a key revenue driver for large-scale parks during traditionally slower months. FEC operators should take note of these seasonal programming techniques to extend their own revenue calendars.

articles.title: Minecraft Moonlight Trail Creates Outdoor IP-Driven Walking Experience Without Screens
articles.summary: Supply + Demand Studio, in partnership with Microsoft and Mojang, has launched Minecraft Experience: Moonlight Trail, a 60-minute outdoor, after-dark walking experience that immerses guests in Minecraft biomes through environmental storytelling and physical exploration rather than screens or handheld devices. The technology-invisible design philosophy represents an emerging model for IP-based location-based entertainment that FEC operators should monitor. As outdoor and hybrid indoor-outdoor FEC formats grow, this approach offers a compelling template for leveraging established IP without heavy screen infrastructure.

articles.title: Bean Sprouts' Imaginibbles Menu Concept Reframes Healthy Kids' Dining Inside Family Venues
articles.summary: Bean Sprouts, a café concept operating inside family destinations across the US, uses its Imaginibbles kids' menu to make healthy food choices fun and visually engaging for children, addressing the common FEC pain point of unsatisfying food-and-beverage offerings. The concept is relevant for FEC operators looking to elevate their dining program as a differentiator and reduce friction for health-conscious parents. A strong F&B offering increasingly drives dwell time and repeat visits in modern FEC formats.

articles.title: Hershey Super Sweet Adventure Shows How CPG Brands Can Power Immersive LBE Without a Narrative Canon
articles.summary: Original X Productions' Hershey Super Sweet Adventure demonstrates that consumer packaged goods brands with no preexisting story universe can still support compelling immersive location-based experiences by using sensory associations and emotional brand equity as narrative material. The project offers a replicable model for FEC operators and experience designers working with non-entertainment brand partners. As more brands seek LBE activations, this case study provides a practical creative framework.

articles.title: Epson Projection Technology Powers Cirque du Soleil ECHO Touring Production
articles.summary: Epson projectors are central to the visual system of Cirque du Soleil's ECHO touring production, tracking a giant cube with 10 projectors positioned around the audience. This application highlights advanced projection mapping techniques increasingly relevant to FEC designers and operators building immersive theater or spectacle experiences. Operators integrating projection-based shows or interactive environments may find the technical approach instructive.
